Search the tag layer

Ask the corpus a cross-field question: which papers, across any discipline, carry the same statistical / concept tags? 1,673 of 1,698 hits open that paper’s page on this site; 25 link to the publisher, because this site has no page for them. 210 show a verbatim sentence, which this page quotes for statistics tags only. Of the other 1,488, 536 are papers the rights manifest does not clear for redistribution, so their tags and facets are here and their sentences are not; 928 are cleared and carry no statistics tag; 24 are cleared and carry statistics tags in a form this index does not read yet, so no sentence is shown for them.
